items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: There was another friend of mine - Louise, Lucille, and Rosita (Shewing,)

ctx.x: They put them in the music scene because they followed all the musicians. They were crazy about musicians but they were two beautiful girls and I think their father was a big political leader and a wonderful Italian man off of Fifth Avenue. Fifth Avenue was a pretty rough street; after jam sessions certain nights we'd all go there. Lucille and Louise were not allowed out, not unless their mother asked me if I was going along with them.
